sector: Generic/cross-sector (reconfigurable supply chain, no industry specified)
key_finding: Conceptual framework only: a dynamic knowledge graph feeds a supply chain digital twin; an AI/metaheuristic optimisation engine suggests reconfigurations that are simulated and validated in the twin before deployment, with actors assessing scenarios; no implementation, named algorithm, or evaluation is provided.
citation_locator: Key finding: Sect. 3 'Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain' (overview paragraphs, Fig. 1, stages 'Data collection', 'Knowledge Graph Construction', 'Optimization and Configuration Selection', 'Implementation and validation'); Sect. 2.3 last paragraph ('we propose a conceptual framework'); Sect. 4 Conclusion. HITL evidence: Sect. 3 second paragraph ('allows actors to explore potential outcomes and assess the impact of disruptions before implementing adjustments'; 'suggest optimal configurations'); Sect. 4 ('AI-driven decision support'); Sect. 1 (human centricity named as a Supply Chain 5.0 goal, not developed). quotes.text: The DT modeling provides a virtual representation of the RSC, which can be used to simulate and analyze different reconfiguration scenarios in real time.
quotes.section: 3 Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain (overview, 2nd paragraph)

quotes.text: This data includes information such as material flows, inventory levels, production capacity and transportation schedules. Once collected, this data will be used to build a DT model that virtually represents the RSC.
quotes.section: 3 Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain, stage 'Data collection'

quotes.text: AI plays a key role in this stage by enriching the KG with missing data through knowledge completion, enrichment or prediction of future events such as demand fluctuations.
quotes.section: 3 Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain, stage 'Knowledge Graph Construction'

quotes.text: Advanced AI techniques, including metaheuristics and prediction can be used to address these complex challenges. These techniques allow different configurations to be compared against predefined criteria
quotes.section: 3 Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain, stage 'Optimization and Configuration Selection'

quotes.text: This step allows actors to explore potential outcomes and assess the impact of disruptions before implementing adjustments in the physical system. The AI-driven optimization engine is employed to evaluate and suggest optimal configurations.
quotes.section: 3 Framework for Intelligent Reconfigurable Supply Chain (overview, 2nd paragraph) - HITL evidence

quotes.text: To address these gaps, we propose a conceptual framework that integrates KG, AI, optimization and DT to enable an intelligent approach to RSC.
quotes.section: 2.3 AI and Optimization in the Supply Chain Reconfiguration (last paragraph)
